results.title: World is born
results.brief_description: Sequence from “Fantasia” interpreting Stravinsky’s “Rites of Spring”. Depicts the first two billion years of the earth’s existence and it formation, convulsions, and upheavals and the first living creatures: unicellular forms, the first amphibians, the dinosaurs, the struggle for existence among the prehistoric monsters and the end of their era.

results.title: World in remembrance
results.brief_description: Follows the solemn funeral procession of Sir Winston Churchill from Westminster to St. Paul’s Cathedral and then down the river Thames. Royal personages and heads of government from around the world paid tribute to the great statesman, who held sway over the forces of land, sea, and air in Britain’s darkest hours.

results.title: World in a marsh
results.brief_description: An intimate view of the miniature cosmos that seethes in a ferment of beauty and savagery behind the tall reeds and in the quiet waters of the marsh. We see how strange insects, small amphibious creatures and birds that prefer waters haunts, devour and are devoured, according to nature’s stern decree of balance and survival of the fittest.

results.title: World garden
results.brief_description: Springtime in Kew Gardens, London, finds daffodiels, bluebells, and cherry blossom in full flower; in the hothouses, exotic plants from the tropics, the Andes and the Himalayas are in bloom. In these beautiful surroundings Londoners find relaxation for themselves and an ideal playground for their children. In the herbarium, an important part of Kew Gardens, research into ways of controlling plant pests and plant diseases goes on year by year, while in another section, botanists classify and study specimens of rare plants sent to Kew for identification from all over the world.

results.title: World Cup athletics
results.creator_credit: Tony Maylam and International Amateur Athletic Federation
results.brief_description: In September 1977 at Dusseldorf, Germany, a great new world sports series began. Eight teams of top athletes from all continents met to compete for the first ever World Cup of Track and Field Athletics. The film captures some of the most vivid moments and lasting impressions of a unique event, the I.A.A.F. World Cup.

results.title: World beaters
results.brief_description:
Episode of Series “TV Eye”.
This film looks behind the headlines of Japan’s economic miracle to the personal attitudes that make it possible. Also looks at the problems which lie ahead for Japan and the Japanese as the need to keep improving industrial performance puts pressure on the traditional concept of lifetime job security.
